tail:
Batch 23 is authored across the [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/quantum-source-compression-and-cq-capacity.md) and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/quantum-source-compression-and-cq-capacity-examples.md). The manifest, source coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch dependencies, and check results are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-23.notes.md). Coverage documents two full-text treatments per page from [Watrous](https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/~watrous/TQI/TQI.pdf) and [Wilde](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1106.1445v8); all 4 source records fetched successfully.

**Checks:** Proof contracts passed 15/15; proof layout passed for 15 items and 42 steps; rendercheck passed all 17 files; focused dependency and content-policy checks passed. Coverage recorded 23 results with no warnings. Batch 23’s dependency levels match the run graph; the run-wide checker still reports 121 errors in other batches, with none specific to batch 23.

Four items are marked `ready`; eleven are `escalated` pending upstream readiness for suppliers including `lem-finite-alphabet-iid-information-aep` (batch 9), `thm-it-finite-strong-subadditivity` (batch 22), and batch 21’s Holevo, entropy, cq-state, mutual-information, Fano, and entropy-chain-rule items. The readiness records do not constitute independent approval.

The phase precheck reported seven `untagged-steps` failures and two repair proposals because it looks for tags on each numbered opening line. I retained the required end-of-step tags, which pass proof-layout, and recorded this checker mismatch in the notes. No tests were run.
